analysis: Changed behavior in ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy.swift: (1) head line 75 replaces the single exact ID constant qwen38ConstrainedModelID with ModelRuntimeRequirements.qwen38ConcreteModelIDs.contains(model.id), still ANDed with Qwen35TemplateFix.applies, so advertisement of forced tool_choice capability may widen to additional concrete Qwen3.8 IDs (tests add EigenLabs/Qwen3.8-27B-4bit-mtp). The contents of qwen38ConcreteModelIDs are outside the supplied evidence; the next pass should confirm it is a closed, explicit exact-ID set, not prefix or pattern matching. (2) head line 151: validateParser now treats any modelType with prefix "qwen3_5" as nativeQwen, so the framed format becomes .qwen35 instead of .nemotron. This applies only under the .structuredPostValidation strategy. The strategy is reached via forcedStrategy only for Qwen35TemplateFix-applicable contexts, native structured targets, or mimo_v2, so the prefix check does not itself admit new models. It only fixes the framed parser selection for Qwen3.5-family models. validateParser still accepts only .xmlFunction or the family-framed format, so withheld post-validation is not weakened. No change to encryption, attestation, or the coordinator/provider auth boundary. No plaintext exposure, cache or key-handling changes touch T-041, T-008 or other threats. The test changes add qwen3_5 and the -mtp model, consistent with the intent. Remaining unverified assumptions: Qwen35TemplateFix.applies semantics and the qwen38ConcreteModelIDs contents. The coordinator's routing use of toolConstraintModels is out of scope here. No findings.
